```yaml
name: Helm Chart CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'helm/**'
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'helm/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint-test:
    name: Lint and Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@fe7b79cd5ee1e45176fcad797de68ecaf3ca4814
        with:
          version: v3.14.0

      - name: Run chart-testing (lint)
        run: |
          ct lint --config .github/ct.yaml --charts helm/falkordb-browser

      - name: Create kind cluster
        uses: helm/kind-action@0025e74a8c7512023d06dc019c617aa3cf561fde
        with:
          version: v0.20.0
          node_image: kindest/node:v1.28.0

      - name: Run chart-testing (install)
        run: |
          ct install --config .github/ct.yaml --charts helm/falkordb-browser

  package-publish:
    name: Package and Publish
    needs: lint-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v'))
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@fe7b79cd5ee1e45176fcad797de68ecaf3ca4814
        with:
          version: v3.14.0

      - name: Install yq
        run: |
          YQ_VERSION="v4.40.5"
          YQ_SHA256="019b054994c698b52865a49f798d38b571023bb786c97f1f01c2fed12efb3bed"
          curl -sL "https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/${YQ_VERSION}/yq_linux_amd64" -o yq
          echo "${YQ_SHA256}  yq" | sha256sum -c -
          chmod +x yq
          sudo mv yq /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Determine Chart Version
        id: version
        run: |
          if [[ $GITHUB_REF == refs/tags/* ]]; then
            VERSION=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}
            # Remove 'v' prefix if present for semver compatibility in helm
            VERSION=${VERSION#v}
          else
            # For main branch, use a dev version based on commit short sha
            VERSION="0.0.0-dev.${GITHUB_SHA::7}"
          fi
          echo "version=${VERSION}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Package Chart
        run: |
          mkdir -p .cr-release-packages
          helm package helm/falkordb-browser --version ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }} --app-version ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }} -d .cr-release-packages

      - name: Checkout Helm Charts Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          repository: FalkorDB/helm-charts
          token: ${{ secrets.GHCR_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          path: helm-charts-repo

      - name: Copy Chart to Repository
        run: |
          cp .cr-release-packages/*.tgz helm-charts-repo/charts/

      - name: Update Index
        run: |
          cd helm-charts-repo
          helm repo index . --url https://falkordb.github.io/helm-charts

      - name: Commit and Push
        run: |
          cd helm-charts-repo
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Add FalkorDB Browser chart version ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" || exit 0
          git push origin main || git push --force origin main
```
